what: Hybrid model design and a first local moment detector that drives the turn gate
why: For the beer handoff the arm has to move while a hand is in view, so a local detector decides which hand presence is acceptable and when to request a turn, and a router sends the move to Dream or the local controller.
details: A steady offered can (0.4 s) requests the turn; an extra hand, a jerked can or a detector failure revokes it through the unchanged turn gate. Dream does the full move when the median of the last 5 round trips is at most 850 ms; local otherwise and on the real arm; the last centimetre is always local. Recommended detector: YOLO26n plus YOLO26n-pose as TensorRT FP16 engines on the Orin Nano. 27 offline tests and a synthetic replay pass. Not yet run on a real camera, real Ultralytics models, the Orin or an arm; thresholds untuned. Proposal for the team: a steady offered can sends request_turn.
